market_question: Iran agrees to surrender enriched uranium stockpile by May 31, 2026?
reasoning: Iran may agree to a symbolic transfer of a small amount of enriched uranium within 13 months under US diplomatic and military pressure, meeting the broad resolution criteria. The market's 3.2% implied probability underestimates the chance of even a token concession.
evidence_points: Resolution rules count any amount of enriched uranium transferred outside Iranian control, not just the full stockpile.
Under the 2015 JCPOA, Iran shipped out low-enriched uranium to Russia, showing a precedent for such concessions.
The Trump administration’s maximum-pressure campaign and threats of military action could push Iran to make a limited gesture to avoid escalation.
